definitions.full: H8131. sena [ שְׂנָא ] verb hate ( סְנָא ᵑ7 , Syriac ; see Biblical Hebrew שָׂנֵא ); — Pe`al Participle plural suffix שׂנאיך Kt, שָֽׂנְאָךְ Qr (K § 53, 2, Anm. b )) Dan 4:16 = thy foes (Biblical Hebrew 3 , MI 4 , Sabean).
